comment: Thrown when an error occurs parsing media data and metadata.

variables.name: contentIsMalformed
variables.comment:
* Whether the parsing error was caused by a bitstream not following the expected format. May be
   * false when a parser encounters a legal condition which it does not support.

variables.name: dataType
variables.comment: The {@link DataType data type} of the parsed bitstream.
